notes.title: Santa Event
notes.notes:
Now through the end of the year, there is a limited time Santa Suit that can randomly drop from:
[list]
[*] Slimes
[*] Ants
[*] Snakes
[*] Orcs
[*] Zombies
[*] Scorpions
[*] Skeletons
[*] Golems
[*] Howlers
[*] Cyclops
[*] Cats
[/list]
The drop rate increases with each monster in the order listed above.
Once the event ends, any santa suit found will persist, but they will stop dropping. Hurry up and find a good suit before the event ends!

The most noticeable being the dust effect when you run was causing the FPS to drop below 20 in most cases. This no longer occurs with v1.21.6

notes.title: v1.21.3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Add Cape of Destruction
[*] Add limited time turkey quest and turkeys fluttering throughout town
[/list]
This update adds the Cape of Destruction which can initially be picked up from the ground in the Contested Land. This cape greatly increases all damage to whoever wears it, but only one person can ever wear it at a time. This item ALWAYS drops if the owner dies. This item is also LOST if the owner logs out or leaves the Contested Land (it resets to the ground for another person to take it). Also, the map in CL will always tell you where the cape is and who has it. Take down the owner and the cape is yours!

notes.title: v1.19.25

Small update, changes:

[*] Modify chat so that only the ENTER key initiates typing chat

[*] Update inventory bag so that you can CTRL+drag to auto stagger items

[*] Change new items in bag inventory so they stagger on entry

[*] Minor modifications to various text colors and sizes to make them more readable

[/list]

notes.title: Howlbreath Steam Release Event
notes.notes:
With Howlbreath's release on Steam, we're starting a competition to win gold, statted hauberks/chain hose, and rare weapons by unlocking level achievements! The following can be won by unlocking achievements:
Unlock Level 20 Achievement by November 14th: 20k gold
Unlock Level 50 Achievement by November 14th: 50k gold
Unlock Level 80 Achievement by November 14th: Choice of Hauberk (21% HP Regen) or Hauberk (21% MP Regen)
Unlock Level 100 Achievement by November 14th: Choice of Chain Hose (15% Physical Absorb) or Chain Hose (15% Magic Absorb) or Sharp Flameberge (49% Hitting Probability) or Virtuous Magic Wand MS20 (49% Hitting Probability)
First player to unlock the Level 120 Warrior Achievement: Choice of Iferag Blade, Lizoga Blade, Abalrien Sword, Ensanguined Blade, Ensanguined Axe, or Ensanguined Rapier
First player to unlock the Level 120 Magician Achievement: Choice of Magic Wand (MS30), Iferag Wand (MS20), Azzurian Wand (MS20), Lizoga Wand (MS20), or Revitalization Wand (MS20)

Every player can earn multiple prizes. Only 1 player can earn prizes from the last 2 categories. Get ready for the release and start earning prizes!
